verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated Third-Party Risk Management product. Its TPRM Agent automatically discovers vendors to build the inventory, speeds up assessments and monitors third-party risk (vanta-docs-13). It also extracts findings from vendors' SOC 2 reports, DPAs and questionnaires to assess security posture (vanta-docs-14). This replaces a spreadsheet for the core of the story, though the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of tracking each vendor's data access, documented per-vendor review cadence or reminders (the cadence claim in vanta-docs-22 is on the general risk page, not vendor-specific), in-depth first-party docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
